sunrise-coral.$description: Sunrise Coral — Orange supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

coral-glow.$description: Coral Glow — Gradient endpoint paired with Sunrise Coral for decorative membership card wash

carbon-black.$description: Carbon Black — Primary text, floating navigation bar fill, headings, icon strokes

pure-black.$description: Pure Black — Logo wordmark, deep contrast borders

zinc-gray.$description: Zinc Gray — Body text, secondary descriptions, muted metadata, helper copy

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Tertiary text, inactive borders, disabled states

mist-gray.$description: Mist Gray — Hairline borders, card outlines, divider lines, button borders

fog-gray.$description: Fog Gray — Subtle surface elevation, muted backgrounds, image overlay scrim base

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page background, card surfaces, text on dark images, button text

nb-international-pro.$description: Everything — display, headings, body, UI, nav. The signature choice is the aggressively tight negative tracking that scales with size (-0.025em at 66px down to -0.005em at small body) combined with line-heights that compress as sizes grow, giving headlines a monolithic, poster-like density that distinguishes Superpower from airy health-tech competitors

nb-international-mono-pro.$description: Tabular metadata, micro-copy annotations, technical labels — used sparingly for moments requiring a clinical/instrumented feel
